entities.name: Q5J2D6
observations: The 373-aa query sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed Rattus norvegicus gametogenetin-binding protein 1 (UniProt Q5J2D6).

UniProt reference annotation: may promote DNM1L-dependent mitochondrial fission and mitochondrial morphogenesis during spermatogenesis; localization reported in cytoplasm, membranes, Golgi, and mitochondrial intermembrane space.
Sequence estimates: 40.85 kDa, pI 5.78, GRAVY −0.724; Pfam detects a Ubiquitin_3 domain at residues 285–371. These are sequence-derived properties, not experimental measurements.
